items.headline: Lindsay Clancy trial: Jury returns for 5th day of deliberations
items.detail: The trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mom who killed her three young children in January 2023, has reached its final stages.

items.headline: Tiger Woods changes plea in DUI case, driver's license suspended for 5 years
items.detail: Tiger Woods appeared in court in Florida Wednesday to change his plea in his driving under the influence case.

items.headline: Labor Day travel forecast: Gas prices may reach record high
items.detail: Labor Day weekend is almost here and travelers across the country are gearing up to head to the airport or hit the highway for the last vacation of the summer.

items.headline: WATCH: Survivor speaks out after lightning strike
items.detail: ABC News' Hanna Battah speaks to the victim, who is now sharing his story after a dramatic lightning strike was caught on camera.
